runtimeAudit.note: 7.1.39 is a narrowly scoped Stage 6 production hotfix. Exact GitHub CI for 7.1.38 proved the instant Stage 6 path and all visual/critical gates, but the secure workflow audit exposed one real inconsistency: the secure student runtime canonicalized teacher-pin case-insensitively while unlock-password remained case-sensitive. 7.1.39 makes the secure runtime canonicalize both teacher-pin and unlock-password, matching the generator helper and instant runtime while preserving domain-separated PBKDF2 salts. Exact GitHub CI remains required for promotion.
